name: Bharatanatyam
description: One of the oldest classical dance forms, characterised by precise footwork, expressive gestures (mudras), and devotional themes.

name: Kathak
description: Storytelling dance form marked by rhythmic footwork, fast spins, and expressive eye movements rooted in Mughal courts.

name: Kathakali
description: Elaborate dance-drama known for vivid makeup, ornate costumes, and depiction of mythological stories.

name: Odissi
description: Graceful classical dance characterised by fluid torso movements and sculpturesque poses inspired by temple carvings.

name: Kuchipudi
description: Dance-drama tradition combining rhythmic footwork with acting, often performed as a narrative sequence.

name: Manipuri
description: Gentle, lyrical dance form rooted in Vaishnavite devotion, featuring soft circular movements and colourful attire.

name: Yakshagana
description: Vibrant traditional theatre combining dance, music, dialogue, and elaborate costumes to enact mythological tales.

name: Chhau
description: Semi-classical martial dance form performed with masks depicting stories from epics and folklore.

name: Warli Painting
description: Tribal art form using simple geometric shapes like circles and triangles to depict daily rural life.

name: Madhubani Painting
description: Vivid folk painting style using natural dyes and pigments, traditionally created by women on mud walls.

name: Pattachitra
description: Intricate cloth-based scroll painting depicting mythological narratives with fine detailing and natural colours.

name: Tanjore Painting
description: Rich, opulent painting style using gold foil and vivid colours to depict Hindu deities and legends.

name: Phulkari
description: Vibrant embroidery technique using darn stitches to create colourful floral patterns on fabric.

name: Bandhani
description: Traditional tie-dye technique creating intricate dotted patterns on fabric through hand tying and dyeing.

name: Chikankari
description: Delicate white-thread embroidery on fine fabric originating from the royal courts of Lucknow.

name: Blue Pottery
description: Distinctive glazed pottery craft using quartz and no clay, known for its striking blue-and-white designs.

name: Pashmina Weaving
description: Exquisite hand-woven shawl craft using fine cashmere wool, prized for its softness and warmth.

name: Gond Painting
description: Tribal art style filled with intricate dots and lines depicting nature, animals, and folklore.

name: Kalamkari
description: Hand-painted or block-printed textile art using natural dyes to depict mythological and floral motifs.

name: Terracotta Craft
description: Ancient clay-based craft producing intricately carved temple panels, pottery, and figurines.
